verdict.line: You lose if Volibear chains Q (Thundering Smash) into a double W (Frenzied Maul) before you've stacked Acquired Taste; you win if you survive to your item power and start converting stacks into Devour picks.

brief.thesis: Volibear's all-in is simply faster than yours: his Q (Thundering Smash, 12-10s CD) stuns and closes the gap, then two casts of W (Frenzied Maul) deal bonus damage and heal him before you've built three stacks of An Acquired Taste. That's why he holds both the lane and solo-kill edge over 300 games at 47.3% for Tahm. You stabilize once your passive stacking, Devour (R), and item health totals catch up — this is a lane you survive first, then win.

theirWindow.when: Before you've landed 3 stacks on him
theirWindow.what: He can freely use Q (Thundering Smash) to stun-engage and double-cast W (Frenzied Maul) for the bonus damage and heal with no fear of your stun or Devour. Poke with Q (Tongue Lash, 900 range) instead of trading in melee.

yourWindow.when: Once Acquired Taste hits 3 stacks on him
yourWindow.what: Choose one: Devour (R, 0s cooldown) to remove him from the fight with magic damage, or land another Q (Tongue Lash) to consume the stacks for a stun and follow with W (Abyssal Dive) for the knockup. You can't do both off the same stack window.

start.why: 50% win rate over 254 games and the 63% pick choice; the passive damage reduction on autos directly answers Volibear's early poke from W (Frenzied Maul).

boots.why: 45.8% win rate over 177 games and the most-picked boots; tenacity shortens how long Q (Thundering Smash)'s stun locks you in place for his follow-up.

core.why: The highest-winrate core path (51.9% over 27 games) starts here; stacking health directly scales your passive's bonus damage and your E (Thick Skin) shield size.
Second item in the best-performing build path, keeps your power spike on schedule into the mid game.
Completes the top-winrate path (51.9%); punishes Volibear's on-hit-heavy W (Frenzied Maul) trading and his passive attack-speed autos.

volibear is rushing frenzied maul recasts and healing off every trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off your autos in extended trades and rewards the slow, sustained poke-then-stack pattern you need to reach 3 Acquired Taste stacks safely.

summoners.why: Flash+Exhaust posts the highest win rate of the three common pages (54.2%, even at just 5.8% pick) because Exhaust directly neutralizes Volibear's Q-into-double-W all-in combo. Flash+Teleport (45.2%, 20.1% pick) is the more common choice if you'd rather prioritize wave management and scaling into side lanes.

playing.title: Poke with Q before committing
playing.detail: Use Q (Tongue Lash, 900 range) to chip stacks and slow him from range rather than walking into his 300-range Q (Thundering Smash) engage.

playing.title: Respect his Q cooldown windows
playing.detail: Thundering Smash is 12-10s on cooldown by rank; track when he's used it and only trade in melee during that window.

playing.title: Save E for his double W
playing.detail: Hold Thick Skin's stored damage for when he recasts W (Frenzied Maul) on you for the bonus damage and heal, then pop the shield to blunt it.

playing.title: Pick Devour or the stun, not both
playing.detail: At 3 Acquired Taste stacks, decide whether Devour (R) secures a kill outright or whether you need the Q-stun into W (Abyssal Dive) knockup for a group lockdown.

playing.title: Don't contest level 3-5 all-ins
playing.detail: Once he has Sky Splitter (E), his full combo outpaces your stack count; play for sustain and wave state instead of trades.

playing.title: Threaten picks from level 6 on
playing.detail: Devour has 0s cooldown once stacks are up, so overextensions by Volibear after minute 6-7 are real kill windows even without Flash up.

playing.title: Scale into Heartsteel before forcing fights
playing.detail: Your trading improves sharply once Heartsteel's stacked health comes online; avoid forcing all-ins until that item spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win/pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: His (W) makes him a strong melee fighter. Victory will go to whoever makes fewer mistakes. Try to use [Q] to poke before closing in to kill him safely.
